WELCOME.TITLE: Welcome to DBExec 👋
WELCOME.DESC: Here's a quick tour of the things you can do. You can stop any time — and tick "Don't show this again" to skip it on future logins.

DONE.TITLE: You're all set 🎉
DONE.DESC: That's the tour. Explore at your own pace — and you can turn this tour back on any time from your profile.

search.TITLE: Global search
search.DESC: Jump to anything fast. Search across your datasets, dashboards, connections and more from here — or press Ctrl/⌘ + K anywhere.

notifications.TITLE: Notifications
notifications.DESC: Alerts, shares and system messages land here in real time. The badge shows how many are unread.

language.TITLE: Change language
language.DESC: Prefer another language? Pick from ten languages here — the whole app updates instantly and your choice is remembered.

logout.TITLE: Sign out
logout.DESC: When you're done, sign out safely from here. Your session ends and you're returned to the login screen.

systemAdmin.TITLE: System Admin
systemAdmin.DESC: Platform-level administration for operators who manage DBExec across organisations.

orgManagement.TITLE: Organisations
orgManagement.DESC: Create and manage the organisations (tenants) on the platform.

systemRoleManagement.TITLE: System Roles
systemRoleManagement.DESC: Define platform-level roles and the permissions each one grants.

systemGroupManagement.TITLE: System Groups
systemGroupManagement.DESC: Group platform operators and assign them system roles in bulk.

systemUserManagement.TITLE: System Users
systemUserManagement.DESC: Manage the platform operator accounts that run DBExec itself.

home.TITLE: Home
home.DESC: Your starting point — a quick overview and shortcuts to everything you work with.

userManagement.TITLE: Users
userManagement.DESC: Invite people to your organisation and manage their accounts and access.

roleManagement.TITLE: Roles
roleManagement.DESC: Define roles and choose exactly which screens and actions each one unlocks.

groupManagement.TITLE: Groups
groupManagement.DESC: Bundle users into groups and grant roles to the whole group at once.

setupDB.TITLE: Data Sources
setupDB.DESC: Connect the databases DBExec reads from — Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake and more.

dbRoles.TITLE: Database Roles
dbRoles.DESC: Manage the login users and roles inside your connected databases.

dbPrivileges.TITLE: Privileges & Access
dbPrivileges.DESC: Grant and review table- and schema-level privileges on your databases.

connectionManager.TITLE: Connections
connectionManager.DESC: Manage the live query connections used to run SQL against your data sources.

queryRunner.TITLE: SQL Workspace
queryRunner.DESC: Write and run SQL with autocomplete, saved queries and a live results grid.

queryBuilderTab.TITLE: Tabs
queryBuilderTab.DESC: Organise guided query-builder screens into tabs.

queryBuilderSection.TITLE: Sections
queryBuilderSection.DESC: Group related prompts into sections within a query-builder screen.

queryBuilderPrompt.TITLE: Prompts
queryBuilderPrompt.DESC: Design the input prompts that drive parameterised, no-code queries.

queryBuilderScreen.TITLE: Query Builder
queryBuilderScreen.DESC: Assemble tabs, sections and prompts into guided, no-code query screens.

datasetManager.TITLE: Datasets
datasetManager.DESC: Shape reusable datasets — pick columns, add calculated fields and formulas.

analyses.TITLE: Analyses
analyses.DESC: Build charts and visual analyses on top of your datasets.

dashboard.TITLE: Dashboards
dashboard.DESC: Combine visuals into shareable dashboards and publish point-in-time snapshots.

rlsRules.TITLE: RLS Rules
rlsRules.DESC: Set row- and column-level security so each user sees only the data they should.

alertManagement.TITLE: Alerts
alertManagement.DESC: Schedule data checks that email or notify you when a condition is met.

auditLogs.TITLE: Audit Logs
auditLogs.DESC: Review a full trail of who changed what, and when, across the platform.

loginActivity.TITLE: Login Activity
loginActivity.DESC: Track sign-ins and authentication events for security and compliance.

appSettings.TITLE: App Settings
appSettings.DESC: Tune your organisation's look and feel — theme, branding and announcements.

systemSettings.TITLE: System Settings
systemSettings.DESC: Configure platform security, SSO, email and AI features.
